title: Targeting Hsp90alpha to inhibit HMGB1-mediated renal inflammation and fibrosis.
authors: Wei, Huizhi; Ren, Jinhong; Feng, Xiue; Zhao, Chengxiao; Zhang, Yuanlin; Yuan, Hongxia; Yang, Fan; Li, Qingshan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子LM49通过结合Hsp90alpha抑制HMGB1介导的肾脏炎症与纤维化，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Renal fibrosis, a terminal manifestation of chronic kidney disease, is characterized by uncontrolled inflammatory responses, increased oxidative stress, tubular cell death, and imbalanced deposition of extracellular matrix. 5,2'-Dibromo-2,4',5'-trihydroxydiphenylmethanone (LM49), a polyphenol derivative synthesized by our group with excellent anti-inflammatory pharmacological properties, has been identified as a small-molecule inducer of extracellular matrix degradation. Nonetheless, the protective effects and mechanisms of LM49 on renal fibrosis remain unknown. Here, we report LM49 could effectively alleviate renal fibrosis and improve filtration function. Furthermore, LM49 significantly inhibited macrophage infiltration, pro-inflammatory cytokine production and oxidative stress. Interestingly, in HK-2 cells induced by tumour necrosis factor alpha under oxygen-glucose-serum deprivation conditions, LM49 treatment similarly yielded a reduced inflammatory response, elevated cellular viability and suppressed cell necrosis and epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition. Notably, LM49 prominently suppressed the high-mobility group box 1 (HMGB1) expression, nucleocytoplasmic translocation and activation. Mechanistically, drug affinity responsive target stability and cellular thermal shift assay confirmed that LM49 could interact with the target heat shock protein 90 alpha family class A member 1 (Hsp90alpha), disrupting the direct binding of Hsp90alpha to HMGB1 and inhibiting the nuclear export of HMGB1, thereby suppressing the inflammatory response, cell necrosis and fibrogenesis. Furthermore, molecular docking and molecular dynamic simulation revealed that LM49 occupied the N-terminal ATP pocket of Hsp90alpha. Collectively, our findings show that LM49 treatment can ameliorate renal fibrosis through inhibition of HMGB1-mediated inflammation and necrosis via binding to Hsp90alpha, providing strong evidence for its anti-inflammatory and anti-fibrotic actions.
abstract_zh: 肾纤维化是慢性肾脏病的终末表现，其特征为不受控制的炎症反应、氧化应激增强、肾小管细胞死亡以及细胞外基质沉积失衡。5,2'-二溴-2,4',5'-三羟基二苯甲酮（LM49）是我们课题组合成的多酚衍生物，具有优异的抗炎药理特性，已被鉴定为一种细胞外基质降解的小分子诱导剂。然而，LM49对肾纤维化的保护作用及其机制尚不清楚。在此，我们报道LM49能有效缓解肾纤维化并改善滤过功能。此外，LM49显著抑制巨噬细胞浸润、促炎细胞因子产生和氧化应激。有趣的是，在氧-葡萄糖-血清剥夺条件下经肿瘤坏死因子α诱导的HK-2细胞中，LM49处理同样产生降低的炎症反应、升高的细胞活力，并抑制细胞坏死和上皮-间质转化。值得注意的是，LM49显著抑制高迁移率族蛋白B1（HMGB1）的表达、核质转位及激活。机制上，药物亲和响应靶标稳定性和细胞热位移实验证实，LM49能与靶标热休克蛋白90α家族A类成员1（Hsp90α）相互作用，破坏Hsp90α与HMGB1的直接结合，抑制HMGB1的核输出，从而抑制炎症反应、细胞坏死和纤维生成。此外，分子对接和分子动力学模拟揭示，LM49占据Hsp90α的N端ATP口袋。综上，我们的研究结果表明，LM49处理可通过结合Hsp90α抑制HMGB1介导的炎症和坏死，从而改善肾纤维化，为其抗炎和抗纤维化作用提供了有力证据。
